title: PROFIT WARNING: building a fake work desktop with casino windows and an interrupting boss
author: Zestyclose_Ear_4121
selftext:
I'm sharing the free demo of PROFIT WARNING, a solo office comedy I am building with Codex. You write nonsense reports, trade fictional stocks and sneak in Plinko or blackjack while your boss calls to inspect your screen. The demo covers five in-game days.

My process has been to describe the behaviour I want, play the result, then send back screenshots and specific corrections. One example: during the tutorial, I wanted the market to stay on the left, the report at bottom right and the boss above it. Adding new tutorial steps kept disturbing that layout. Another was Plinko: a big batch of identical departures looked wrong, so I asked for staggered starts, like a cascade.

The bigger design correction was progression. Automated production could complete the daily target by itself. We changed the target to include a forecast of passive production plus a separate amount the player needs to earn actively. I'm still tuning it. Getting another feature running has been easier than keeping the whole experience readable and balanced after each change. The game uses web technology with an Electron version for Windows. Code and visuals are AI-assisted; I direct the concept, mechanics, humour and playtest decisions.

Playable demo: [https://lorisdc.itch.io/project-warning-demo](https://lorisdc.itch.io/project-warning-demo)

Desktop browser or Windows, mouse and keyboard. English, French, Spanish, German and Brazilian Portuguese. If you try it, the feedback I need most is whether juggling the windows is enjoyable tension or just clutter.
